advisory: Synopsis: El Niño conditions are present and expected to strengthen into the Northern Hemisphere winter 2026-27.
forecast_summary: El Niño conditions are currently present with the latest weekly Niño-3.4 index at +0.7°C. This indicates weak El Niño conditions. Models suggest a possibility of El Niño conditions developing later in the year. The probability chart below shows the seasonal forecast for La Niña (blue), Neutral (grey), and El Niño (red) conditions through the end of the year.
